property_summary: After initialize, the pool's flash fee must equal the _changeFee argument times 1e14 (i.e. changeFee stores _changeFee); the mutant stores _feeRate there, so any input with _changeFee != _feeRate yields a wrong flashFee.
change_summary: Assign _feeRate to changeFee instead of _changeFee, so changeFee stores the fee rate value.
